items.title: v2 representative frame 228 — left sleeve/forearm absent
items.frame_scope_label: representative frame 228; one of 15/15 held development frames
rejection_reasons: Strict gate: final left boundary support and seeded left boundary arm/sleeve are missing.
Independent visual review: both hands and the can are retained, but the left foreground sleeve/forearm is omitted.

items.title: v2 representative frame 233 — bilateral sleeve/forearm omission
items.frame_scope_label: representative frame 233; last frame before abrupt left-sleeve recovery
rejection_reasons: Strict gate: left final boundary support and both seeded boundary arm/sleeve routes are missing.
Independent visual review: the masks are hand-dominant and omit both required sleeve/forearm regions.

items.title: v2 representative frame 234 — abrupt left-sleeve recovery, right sleeve absent
rejection_reasons: Strict gate: right seeded boundary arm/sleeve is missing and temporal IoU is below the frozen limit.
Independent visual review: the left black sleeve appears abruptly while the right grey sleeve remains omitted.

items.title: v2 representative frame 242 — persistent right sleeve/forearm omission
rejection_reasons: Strict gate: the right seeded boundary arm/sleeve route remains missing.
Independent visual review: hands, left sleeve, can and table remain stable, but the right grey sleeve is still omitted.
